# PartBuilder

The builder `parts.part()` returns: boxes, extrusions, sweeps, connectors and parameters on one part type.

Every example below is a complete script that passes the kit's checks; the kit's tests run each one.

- [`PartBuilder.planSymbol`](#partbuilderplansymbol): Adds 2D plan symbol primitives (`circle`, `rect`, `line`, `arc`, `polyline`, `text`) with `units: "paper"`, `minPaperMm` floors, `fill: "mask" | "solid"`, conditional `when` parameter rules (e.g. emergency battery shading), `mask: true` text wipeouts, and `upright` / `uprightOffset` wall-safe subscripts.
- [`PartBuilder.param`](#partbuilderparam): A type parameter; pass the returned dimension to a body or connector and it follows the parameter on every size.
- [`PartBuilder.box`](#partbuilderbox): A box standing on the base.
- [`PartBuilder.cylinder`](#partbuildercylinder): A cylinder along x, y or z (z stands on the base): a tank, a water heater, a fan.
- [`PartBuilder.transition`](#partbuildertransition): A taper along x between two rectangular openings: width and height both change (fromHeight / toHeight), and offset moves the outlet.
- [`PartBuilder.connector`](#partbuilderconnector): A connector on a face, pointing out of it: duct, pipe, gas or electrical, with its system kind and size.
- [`PartBuilder.build`](#partbuilderbuild): The part-type definition, checked with the kernel's schema and part rules (a problem fails here, in the kernel's words).
- [`PartBuilder.check`](#partbuildercheck): `build` plus the kernel's connector placement warnings (a part with warnings still saves).
- [`PartBuilder.extrude`](#partbuilderextrude): Push a profile (any outline, with holes) straight out of its view between from and to; cut: true removes material instead.
- [`PartBuilder.cut`](#partbuildercut): Remove material with a profile pushed out of its view: openings, recesses, holes through a casing.
- [`PartBuilder.revolve`](#partbuilderrevolve): Turn a profile about a line drawn in the same view (default 360 degrees): bells, domes, nozzles, round tanks with heads.
- [`PartBuilder.sweep`](#partbuildersweep): Carry a profile along straights and bends drawn in a view: elbows, offsets, coil returns, handrails.
- [`PartBuilder.loft`](#partbuilderloft): A solid through two or more sections, each a profile on its own plane: square-to-round transitions, hoods, cones, wye legs.
- [`PartBuilder.pattern`](#partbuilderpattern): Repeat earlier bodies (by id, or "last") in a line or around an axis: coil fins, louvre blades, bolt circles, breaker rows.
- [`PartBuilder.mirror`](#partbuildermirror): A mirrored copy of earlier bodies across the plane square to an axis (at along it; default the centre).
- [`PartBuilder.importBody`](#partbuilderimportbody): A body from a vendor's glTF or OBJ library file, pinned by its content hash (read sanitized and size-capped by the host); at places its origin, turn turns it about z.
- [`PartBuilder.symbol`](#partbuildersymbol): Plan symbol drawn instead of the solid at chosen detail levels: shapes, lines, texts, optional paper-space scaling (`units: "paper"`), minimum plotted paper floor (`minPaperMm` on model-size symbols so true-scale equipment stays legible when zoomed out), opaque white mask (`mask: true`), solid black fill (`filled: true`), and pen weight.
- [`PartBuilder.symbolRef`](#partbuildersymbolref): Attach a registered plan symbol from SYMBOL_POINT (e.g. electrical.plan_duplex, electrical.plan_gfci, electrical.plan_switch, electrical.plan_occ_sensor, electrical.plan_downlight_em) at chosen detail levels.
- [`PartBuilder.clearance`](#partbuilderclearance): Space kept clear in front of a face (service access, combustibles, working space); never solid, checked by clash.
- [`PartBuilder.connectorAt`](#partbuilderconnectorat): A connector at an exact point of the part (x to the front, y to the left, z up), facing out of a face: an outlet on a section, a stub on a hood.
- [`PartBuilder.instanceParam`](#partbuilderinstanceparam): A value each placed copy carries for itself (a panel's name, its mains), with an optional default; shown in properties and schedules, not in the shape.
- [`PartBuilder.draft`](#partbuilderdraft): The definition as built so far, unchecked.

## PartBuilder.planSymbol

Adds 2D plan symbol primitives (`circle`, `rect`, `line`, `arc`, `polyline`, `text`) with `units: "paper"`, `minPaperMm` floors, `fill: "mask" | "solid"`, conditional `when` parameter rules (e.g. emergency battery shading), `mask: true` text wipeouts, and `upright` / `uprightOffset` wall-safe subscripts.

```ts
planSymbol(primitives: readonly SymbolPrimitive[]): PartBuilder
```

Topics: plan symbol, annotative, paper units, minPaperMm, conditional symbol, when, mask, circle, wall_face

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, checks } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "part",
  reads: {},
  parameters: { width: { type: "quantity", kind: "length", unit: "in", label: "Width", default: units.in(24) } },
  run(ctx, v) {
    const b = parts.part("Wall Sensor", { type: "24V", category: "electrical_device", hosting: "wall_face" });
    b.box({ length: units.in(3), width: units.in(1), height: units.in(4.5) });
    b.planSymbol([{ kind: "line", from: [0, 0], to: [0, 1.4], pen: "medium", units: "paper" }, { kind: "circle", center: [0, 2.8], radius: 1.4, fill: "mask", pen: "medium", units: "paper" }, { kind: "text", at: [0, 2.8], text: "WS", heightMm: 1.5, mask: true, units: "paper" }]);
    ctx.parts.define("acme.wall_sensor.24v", b.build());
  },
});
```

</details>

## PartBuilder.param

A type parameter; pass the returned dimension to a body or connector and it follows the parameter on every size.

```ts
param(name: string, spec: { label: string; value: Measure | number | string | boolean; unit?: string }): Dim
```

Topics: parameter, size, formula, type parameter

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, checks } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "part",
  reads: {},
  parameters: { width: { type: "quantity", kind: "length", unit: "in", label: "Width", default: units.in(24) } },
  run(ctx, v) {
    const b = parts.part("Box", { type: "24", category: "generic" });
    const w = b.param("width", { label: "Width", value: v.width });
    b.box({ length: w, width: units.in(12), height: units.in(12) });
    ctx.parts.define("acme.box.24", b.build());
  },
});
```

</details>

## PartBuilder.box

A box standing on the base. The first body is the part's envelope: connectors go on its faces.

```ts
box(size: { length: Length; width: Length; height: Length }, at?: { x?: Length; y?: Length; base?: Length } & BodyOptions): PartBuilder
```

Topics: box, casing, cabinet, rooftop unit, panel, body

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, checks } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "part",
  reads: {},
  parameters: { width: { type: "quantity", kind: "length", unit: "in", label: "Width", default: units.in(24) } },
  run(ctx, v) {
    const b = parts.part("Box", { type: "24", category: "generic" });
    b.box({ length: v.width, width: units.in(12), height: units.in(12) });
    b.box({ length: units.in(6), width: units.in(6), height: units.in(4) }, { base: units.in(12) });
    ctx.parts.define("acme.box.24", b.build());
  },
});
```

## PartBuilder.cylinder

```ts
cylinder(spec: { diameter: Length; length: Length; axis: "x" | "y" | "z" }, at?: { x?: Length; y?: Length; z?: Length } & BodyOptions): PartBuilder
```

## PartBuilder.transition

A taper along x between two rectangular openings: width and height both change (fromHeight / toHeight), and offset moves the outlet. A loft underneath.

```ts
transition(spec: { length: Length; fromWidth: Length; toWidth: Length; height?: Length; fromHeight?: Length; toHeight?: Length; offset?: [Length, Length] } & BodyOptions): PartBuilder
```

Topics: transition, reducer, taper, offset transition

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, checks } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "part",
  reads: {},
  parameters: { width: { type: "quantity", kind: "length", unit: "in", label: "Width", default: units.in(24) } },
  run(ctx, v) {
    const b = parts.part("Transition", { type: "24x16-12x8", category: "duct_accessory" });
    b.transition({ length: units.in(18), fromWidth: v.width, toWidth: units.in(12), fromHeight: units.in(16), toHeight: units.in(8) });
    b.connector("back", { id: "in", label: "Inlet", domain: "duct", systemKind: "supply_air", shape: "rect", width: v.width, height: units.in(16), endType: "mechanical.slip" });
    ctx.parts.define("acme.tr.24x16", b.build());
  },
});
```

</details>

## PartBuilder.connector

A connector on a face, pointing out of it: duct, pipe, gas or electrical, with its system kind and size. Faces are the first body's (envelope) or, with of "body", the box around everything built.

```ts
connector(face: Face, c: ConnectorSpec & { offset?: [Length, Length] }, of?: "envelope" | "body"): PartBuilder
```

## PartBuilder.extrude

Push a profile (any outline, with holes) straight out of its view between from and to; cut: true removes material instead.

```ts
extrude(profile: Profile, spec: { on?: View; at?: Length; from?: Length; to: Length } & BodyOptions): PartBuilder
```

Topics: extrude, profile, hole, curb, casing, body

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, checks } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "part",
  reads: {},
  parameters: { width: { type: "quantity", kind: "length", unit: "in", label: "Width", default: units.in(24) } },
  run(ctx, v) {
    const b = parts.part("Curb", { type: "24", category: "generic" });

});
```

## PartBuilder.sweep

Carry a profile along straights and bends drawn in a view: elbows, offsets, coil returns, handrails. The profile is drawn across the path where it starts.

```ts

```

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts

    const b = parts.part("Elbow", { type: "10 in 90", category: "duct_accessory" });
    b.sweep(parts.circle(units.in(10)), { on: "plan", at: units.in(12), start: [units.in(0), units.in(0)], heading: "right", segments: [{ straight: units.in(4) }, { bend: { radius: units.in(15), angle: 90, turn: "left" } }, { straight: units.in(4) }] });

});
```

```ts
pattern(ids: string[] | "last", spec: { along: "x" | "y" | "z"; count: number; spacing: Length } | { around: "x" | "y" | "z"; count: number; angle?: number; center?: [Length, Length, Length] }, opts?: { id?: string }): PartBuilder
```

## PartBuilder.symbol

Plan symbol drawn instead of the solid at chosen detail levels: shapes, lines, texts, optional paper-space scaling (`units: "paper"`), minimum plotted paper floor (`minPaperMm` on model-size symbols so true-scale equipment stays legible when zoomed out), opaque white mask (`mask: true`), solid black fill (`filled: true`), and pen weight. Levels without a symbol fall back to the solid seen from above.

```ts
symbol(levels: DetailLevel | DetailLevel[], draw: { shapes?: Profile[]; lines?: [[Length, Length], [Length, Length]][]; texts?: { at: [Length, Length]; text: string; heightMm?: number; anchor?: "start" | "middle" | "end" }[]; units?: "model" | "paper"; minPaperMm?: number; pen?: "thin" | "medium" | "wide" | "heavy"; filled?: boolean; mask?: boolean }, view?: "plan" | "below"): PartBuilder
```

Topics: symbol, plan symbol, custom symbol, paper scale, annotative, minPaperMm, minimum paper height, mask, fill, detail level, coarse, fine, drafting

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, checks } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "part",
  reads: {},
  parameters: { width: { type: "quantity", kind: "length", unit: "in", label: "Width", default: units.in(24) } },
  run(ctx, v) {
    const b = parts.part("Box", { type: "24", category: "generic" });
    b.box({ length: v.width, width: units.in(12), height: units.in(12) });
    b.symbol(["coarse", "medium"], { units: "paper", mask: true, shapes: [parts.circle(units.mm(3.2))], lines: [[[units.mm(-0.65), units.mm(-2.5)], [units.mm(-0.65), units.mm(1.45)]], [[units.mm(0.65), units.mm(-2.5)], [units.mm(0.65), units.mm(1.45)]]], texts: [{ at: [units.mm(2.2), units.mm(1.7)], text: "WP", heightMm: 1.7, anchor: "start" }] });
    b.symbol("fine", { units: "model", minPaperMm: 4, mask: true, shapes: [parts.rect(units.in(24), units.in(24))] });
    ctx.parts.define("acme.wp_receptacle", b.build());
  },
});
```

</details>

## PartBuilder.clearance

Space kept clear in front of a face (service access, combustibles, working space); never solid, checked by clash.

```ts
clearance(zone: { id: string; name: string; purpose: string; face: Face; depth: Length; width?: Length; height?: Length; fromFloor?: boolean }): PartBuilder
```

Topics: clearance, service access, working space, keep clear

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, checks } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "part",
  reads: {},
  parameters: { width: { type: "quantity", kind: "length", unit: "in", label: "Width", default: units.in(24) } },
  run(ctx, v) {
    const b = parts.part("Box", { type: "24", category: "generic" });
    b.box({ length: v.width, width: units.in(12), height: units.in(12) });
    b.clearance({ id: "service", name: "Service", purpose: "service_access", face: "front", depth: units.in(36) });
    ctx.parts.define("acme.box.24", b.build());
  },
});
```

</details>

## PartBuilder.connectorAt

A connector at an exact point of the part (x to the front, y to the left, z up), facing out of a face: an outlet on a section, a stub on a hood.

```ts
connectorAt(c: ConnectorSpec & { at: [Length, Length, Length]; facing: Face }): PartBuilder
```

Topics: connector, condensate, drain connection, exact position

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, checks } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "part",
  reads: {},
  parameters: { width: { type: "quantity", kind: "length", unit: "in", label: "Width", default: units.in(24) } },
  run(ctx, v) {
    const b = parts.part("Box", { type: "24", category: "generic" });
    b.box({ length: v.width, width: units.in(12), height: units.in(12) });
    b.connectorAt({ id: "drain", label: "Condensate drain", domain: "pipe", systemKind: "sanitary", shape: "round", diameter: units.in(0.75), at: [units.in(12), units.in(-4), units.in(2)], facing: "front", endType: "plumbing_gas.threaded" });
    ctx.parts.define("acme.box.24", b.build());
  },
});
```

</details>

## PartBuilder.instanceParam

A value each placed copy carries for itself (a panel's name, its mains), with an optional default; shown in properties and schedules, not in the shape.

```ts
instanceParam(name: string, spec: { label: string; kind: "text" | "number" | "boolean" | "choice"; default?: string | number | boolean; unit?: string; choices?: string[] }): PartBuilder
```

Topics: instance parameter, per copy, panel name, property

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, checks } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "part",
  reads: {},
  parameters: { width: { type: "quantity", kind: "length", unit: "in", label: "Width", default: units.in(24) } },
  run(ctx, v) {
    const b = parts.part("Box", { type: "24", category: "generic" });
    b.box({ length: v.width, width: units.in(12), height: units.in(12) });
    b.instanceParam("panel_name", { label: "Panel name", kind: "text", default: "LP-1" });
    ctx.parts.define("acme.box.24", b.build());
  },
});
```

</details>

## PartBuilder.draft

The definition as built so far, unchecked.

```ts
draft(): PartTypeDefinition
```

Topics: draft

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, checks } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "part",
  reads: {},
  parameters: { width: { type: "quantity", kind: "length", unit: "in", label: "Width", default: units.in(24) } },
  run(ctx, v) {
    const b = parts.part("Box", { type: "24", category: "generic" });
    b.box({ length: v.width, width: units.in(12), height: units.in(12) });
    const draft = b.draft();
    ctx.parts.define("acme.box.24", { ...draft, description: "A drafted box" });
  },
});
```

</details>
